title: Make the collection easier to scan at a glance
description: The Library landing page now foregrounds ROM totals, check and publication queues, and console-level checked and attention counts. Search and display controls use a compact, consistent layout while cover browsing, filters, saved views, selection, verification, RomM publishing, and file details remain available.
limitations: Artwork availability still depends on linked RomM metadata. Other application pages have not been redesigned.
